bitcoin_articles.headline: Franklin Templeton Launches Two ETFs Combining U.S. Equities and Bitcoin
bitcoin_articles.summary: Franklin Templeton has introduced two new exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that integrate U.S. equity exposure with Bitcoin through a systematic dividend reinvestment strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Datavault AI Shares Plunge Following Disclosure of Inaccessible Bitcoin Assets and Financial Restatements
bitcoin_articles.summary: Datavault AI shares fell nearly 50% after the company disclosed it could not withdraw bitcoin linked to a $150 million share purchase agreement, necessitating a restatement of multiple financial periods.
